title: Matrix-free voxel elasticity on GPUs: artifact repository
description: Artifact repository of the paper "Matrix-free voxel elasticity on GPUs: a reproducible kernel and multigrid study across precisions and hardware" by Abderrazzak Nejeoui and Aissam Bekkari. It contains the code, the protocols (frozen before execution), the verified evidence and the build scripts that regenerate every number, table and figure reported in the paper. Each experiment is one commit with an annotated tag. The large raw evidence archives are published separately: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22998404.
